WITH RankedDisasters AS (
    SELECT 
        ba.beneregistry AS beneficiary_registry_id,
        ba.benedistref AS disaster_reference,
        ba.commengagelvl AS cee_score,
        de.classification,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ba.commengagelvl ORDER BY de.classification) AS rank
    FROM 
        beneficiariesandassessments AS ba
    JOIN 
        disasterevents AS de ON ba.benedistref = de.distregistry
)
SELECT 
    beneficiary_registry_id,
    disaster_reference,
    cee_score,
    classification,
    rank
FROM 
    RankedDisasters
ORDER BY 
    cee_score, rank;
